The '''X-15 Riot Sniper Rifle''' was a type of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]] produced during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

During the [[Showdown on Ruhnuk]], [[Clan Ha'rangir]] stored shipments of the weapon for use by the [[Hidden Chain]].<ref name="Beast">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Iron Beast|[[Ruhnuk]]}}</ref>
